entities.name: Adalimumab
observations: In a 2025 nationwide ankylosing spondylitis cohort, adalimumab was associated with lower recurrent acute anterior uveitis risk versus no bDMARD exposure (adjusted HR 0.798, 95% CI 0.659–0.968).

In a Korean TNF-inhibitor cohort, acute anterior uveitis occurrence was lower with adalimumab than etanercept; etanercept versus adalimumab IRR was 1.78 overall and 1.86 among patients with prior uveitis.
Available evidence does not establish adalimumab-specific absolute recurrence rates or a recurrence-only randomized trial effect.

entities.name: Ankylosing spondylitis
observations: Adalimumab-associated reduction in acute anterior uveitis recurrence/risk is supported by nationwide observational evidence and comparative TNF-inhibitor data.

entities.name: Acute anterior uveitis
observations: Pooled randomized-trial evidence found fewer anterior uveitis flares with anti-TNF monoclonal antibodies versus placebo (OR 0.46, 95% CI 0.24–0.90), but this class-level result does not isolate adalimumab.
